title: Independent Qualification of Explicit Head-Budget Normalization for the Richards Temporal Indicator
scope: independent normalization qualification only; no numeric H_budget admission, no production certificate activation, no retry-policy binding, no coupling release

independent_exact_linear_matrix.role: independent theorem-scope reconstruction using a scalar dissipative backward-Euler mode; points differ from F-SI26 owner matrix
independent_exact_linear_matrix.required: abs(y_BE-y_exact)<=B_inf_scalar and, for every valid synthetic budget, C_h<=1 implies abs(y_BE-y_exact)<=H_budget

synthetic_budget_semantics.selection_basis: simple fixed decade values frozen before execution; not derived from observed B_inf values
synthetic_budget_semantics.required_scaling: For fixed B_inf, multiplying H_budget by 10 divides C_h by 10 within floating arithmetic.
synthetic_budget_semantics.threshold_equivalence: For valid inputs, C_h<=1 iff B_inf<=H_budget.

fresh_nonlinear_production_matrix.role: fresh production-indicator normalization/noninterference matrix; not a truth or error-bound matrix
fresh_nonlinear_production_matrix.production_route: reference Richards production indicator with transaction-owned previous derivative history as already independently qualified by F-VQ31

invalid_input_matrix.required: certificate unavailable/fail closed; no clamping, floor or default substitution

gates.G01_SOURCE_AND_CANDIDATE_LOCK: All source blobs, F-SI26 decision and exact C_h formula match the frozen plan.
gates.G02_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_LINEAR_RECONSTRUCT: All frozen scalar x cases reproduce the theorem-scope B_inf upper-bound relation without using F-SI26 owner test points.
gates.G03_DIMENSIONLESS_BUDGET_ALGEBRA: All valid probes satisfy finiteness, nonnegativity, threshold equivalence and exact decade scaling; no hidden default budget exists.
gates.G04_INVALID_INPUT_FAIL_CLOSED: Invalid/unavailable B_inf or H_budget produces unavailable/fail-closed certificate with no rescue value.
gates.G05_FRESH_NONLINEAR_PRODUCTION_NORMALIZA: All 12 frozen fresh production cases yield finite nonnegative B_inf and valid C_h for all three synthetic budgets without modifying the production indicator path.
gates.G06_NONINTERFERENCE_AND_COST: Normalization adds no nonlinear trajectory, no tridiagonal solve, changes no state/flux/mass and all principal attempts retain the 1e-12 hard mass gate.
gates.G07_O0_O2: Machine-readable fresh nonlinear B_inf and normalized C_h summaries are bitwise identical under O0/O2 current convention.
gates.G08_NONLINEAR_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: No fresh nonlinear case is interpreted as true-error validation and no N512/deep finite reference is run or promoted.
gates.G09_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_PRESERVED: F-VQ28 retry nonmonotonicity and F-VQ29 insufficient-reference findings remain authoritative; shorter-dt monotonicity is not assumed.
gates.G10_FKT09_COMPATIBILITY_NO_ACTIVATION: C_h is structurally compatible with F-KT09 finite nonnegative <=1 certificate input, but F-VQ32 does not activate production temporal acceptance or select policy.
gates.G11_ARCHITECTURE_INVARIANTS: Explicitly reconcile invariants 7,8,9,11,12,13,15,20,23,24,25,26,29,30 with no coupling or F-PE release.

pass_rules: All G01-G11 pass exactly as frozen.
All 6 exact-linear scalar cases are retained regardless of outcome.
All 12 fresh nonlinear cases and all 3 synthetic budget probes are retained regardless of outcome.
No H_budget value is promoted from synthetic probe to scientific/application tolerance.
No multiplier, floor, state/material coefficient, q_cap, Nmin or tail model is added after execution.
Any source-lock, exact-linear, invalid-input, nonlinear execution, mass, cost, O0/O2 or claim-boundary failure prevents PASS.
hard_nonclaims: No numeric H_budget is qualified for applications.
No universal temporal tolerance is selected.
No nonlinear true-error upper bound is qualified.
No monotone retry improvement is qualified.
No production F-KT certificate acceptance/retry policy is admitted.
No initial bootstrap, arbitrary restart or forcing/event/topology-discontinuity continuation is qualified.
No F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE release follows.
next_action: After this plan commit, implement an independent VQ-owned scalar theorem/algebra gate and a fresh 12-case production-indicator normalization harness without changing production source or candidate semantics.
